verdict.rationale: Consensus documents a Library that imports thousands of papers from Zotero, BibTeX, PDF, or RIS. It describes that library as a searchable, AI-powered workspace where you can 'search, find gaps, and put your collection to work', which covers uploading your own corpus and researching over it. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the Research Agent or Deep Search can be scoped to run over the user's uploaded library (versus the 200M-paper corpus), details on how uploaded PDFs are analyzed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
